name: Christopher Nolan
biography: Christopher Edward Nolan CBE is a British-American filmmaker known for making large-scale, high-concept films that challenge conventional narrative structure. Born in London in 1970, he began his career directing low-budget independent films before breaking through with Memento (2000). His films routinely push the boundaries of commercial and art-house cinema, combining complex storytelling with stunning practical effects and IMAX cinematography. He has directed four of the top-grossing films of their respective years, and The Dark Knight is widely considered one of the greatest films ever made.
